statement: Outside Book Dash, whose format fixes 12 spreads, 1 of 3 analysed books runs 12 pages (Chicken and Millipede, African Storybook); Good Night, Monu (StoryWeaver) runs 13 and Bohlale's adventure (African Storybook) 15. The 12-spread pattern is not yet shown beyond one publisher.

scope.population: contemporary open-licence picture books: Book Dash (13), African Storybook (2), StoryWeaver/Pratham Books (1); 2014-2025

analyst_note:
2026-10-14: Best Friends and An Unexpected Adventure (wordless) reviewed for this claim. Caution: all 7 are Book Dash, whose format fixes the spread count, so more Book Dash books do not answer the one-publisher objection; a second source is still required.
2026-10-15: Rewritten to the cross-publisher question the owner asked for. The 13 Book Dash books (all 12 spreads, a format rule) are no longer counted as support because they cannot test it. Word totals also split: the six 3-4 Book Dash books added today run 60-118 words (Zuko is wordless), below the earlier 136-220; non-Book Dash books run 168-569. Sources of the new works: Chicken and Millipede and Bohlale's adventure from African Storybook, Good Night, Monu from StoryWeaver.

magicpaper.suggested: Similar total length, but these books spend it on ~12 page turns of ~10-20 words. Worth testing shorter pages and more turns once the corpus is larger.
magicpaper.note: One publisher, one country. Do not act on this before ≥10 books from ≥2 sources agree.
